card.name: Citations of the Gospel of John
card.fires_on: Punctuation or numbers right after a citation of John's Gospel (Jn. or John), such as the colon, space or chapter digit before the verse numbers. It also fires on the opening bracket before John.

modes.label: Colon after chapter
modes.description: The colon between chapter and verse in a John reference.

modes.label: Chapter digit or space
modes.description: The space or first digit right after Jn or John.

modes.label: Bracket before John
modes.description: An opening bracket just before a John reference.

card.writes: It pushes the name John and its variants as the next word, which fits a reference to John.
card.plain: It lights up inside Bible references to the Gospel of John, around the chapter and verse numbers.
